jobs.title: Legal Operations & Artificial Intelligence Intern
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: Ideal Start date : September 2026 Take your first steps into a fulfilling career and join our team as an intern! Curious about how AI is transforming business, legal and innovation landscapes? If yes, we would love to see your profile as we are looking for our next intern to join our Legal team for a 6-month period. About us TotalEnergies has developed a strong expertise in oil and biofuels, natural gas and electricity trading. Trading entities are based in Geneva, Paris, Houston and Singapore. TotalEnergies installed its European trading hub across in Geneva, which now bring together very large teams around trading activities : TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping (T&S) and TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP). T&S is a trading company in charge of all physical trading and shipping of crude oil and refined products on behalf of the TotalEnergies Company. It has been an active participant all over the supply chain as well as on the derivatives paper market in order to manage the market risk for a long time. TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP) is the trading arm of TotalEnergies in the field of low carbon energies. As such, it operates in fast-evolving market dynamics influenced by internal and external factors that require constant adaptation and evolution. Activities: Luminance it a new solution combining contract management, workflow automation, metadata extraction and artificial intelligence to support contract creation, review, negotiation and governance activities across the organization. You will support the deployment, configuration, testing and continuous improvement of Luminance across the Trading business:
• Participate in configuration and testing of Luminance functionalities and workflows.
• Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and document issues and enhancement opportunities.
• Contribute to AI-powered contractual risk analysis tools and playbooks.
• Assist in prompt development, testing and optimisation for contract review.
• Support metadata extraction, validation and contract intelligence initiatives.
• Assist in the creation and maintenance of templates, clause libraries and negotiation playbooks.
• Prepare training materials, presentations and communication packs.
• Support change management and user adoption activities.
• Coordinate user feedback and support issue tracking.
• Contribute to innovation initiatives involving Generative AI, automation and Legal Tech. Candidate Profile:
• You are currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Law, Business, Engineering, Innovation, Legal Tech, or a related field
• You have a strong interest in Artificial Intelligence, digital transformation and emerging technologies
• You have excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, combined with strong organisational abilities
• You have clear and confident communication skills, both written and verbal
• You are able to manage multiple priorities, work independently and deliver in a fast-paced environment
• You are curious, proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with a strong team spirit
• A tri-partite internship agreement is mandatory Additional Information: TotalEnergies values diversity, promotes individual growth and offers equal opportunity careers.

Contesto e ambiente: Ideal Data di inizio: Settembre 2026 Fai i tuoi primi passi in una carriera soddisfacente e unisciti alla nostra squadra come tirocinante! Curioso su come l'IA sta trasformando i paesaggi aziendali, legali e innovativi? Se sì, ci piacerebbe vedere il tuo profilo come stiamo cercando il nostro prossimo tirocinante per unire il nostro team legale per un periodo di 6 mesi. TotalEnergies ha sviluppato una forte esperienza nel commercio di petrolio e biocarburanti, gas naturale e elettricità. Le società di trading hanno sede a Ginevra, Parigi, Houston e Singapore. TotalEnergies ha installato il suo hub di trading europeo a Ginevra, che ora riunisce squadre molto grandi circa le attività di trading: TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping (T&S) e TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP). T&S è una società di trading responsabile di tutte le attività di trading fisico e di spedizione di petrolio grezzo e prodotti raffinati per conto della TotalEnergies Company. È stato un partecipante attivo in tutta la filiera e sul mercato della carta dei derivati al fine di gestire il rischio di mercato per lungo tempo. TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP) è il braccio di trading di TotalEnergies nel campo delle basse energie di carbonio. Come tale, opera in dinamiche di mercato in rapida evoluzione influenzate da fattori interni ed esterni che richiedono un costante adattamento ed evoluzione. Attività: Luminance è una nuova soluzione che combina la gestione del contratto, l'automazione del flusso di lavoro, l'estrazione di metadati e l'intelligenza artificiale per sostenere le attività di creazione, revisione, negoziazione e governance di contratto in tutta l'organizzazione. Sosterrai l'implementazione, la configurazione, il test e il miglioramento continuo di Luminance attraverso il business Trading:
• Partecipa alla configurazione e alla sperimentazione di funzionalità e flussi di lavoro Luminance.
• Supporto test di accettazione utente (UAT) e problemi di documento e opportunità di miglioramento.
• Contribuisci agli strumenti di analisi dei rischi contrattuali basati su AI e ai playbook.
• Assistere nello sviluppo rapido, nel test e nell'ottimizzazione della revisione dei contratti.
• Sostenere le iniziative di estrazione, validazione e intelligenza dei contratti.
• Assistere nella creazione e manutenzione di modelli, librerie di clausole e librerie di negoziazione.
• Preparare materiali di formazione, presentazioni e pacchetti di comunicazione.
• Supporta la gestione dei cambiamenti e le attività di adozione degli utenti.
• Coordinare il feedback degli utenti e il monitoraggio dei problemi di supporto.
• Contribuire a iniziative di innovazione che coinvolgono AI Generativo, automazione e Legal Tech. Profilo del candidato:
• Attualmente si sta perseguendo un master in Diritto, Affari, Ingegneria, Innovazione, Legal Tech, o un campo relativo
• Hai un forte interesse per l'intelligenza artificiale, la trasformazione digitale e le tecnologie emergenti
• Hai eccellenti capacità analitiche e di problem solving, combinate con forti capacità organizzative
• Hai competenze di comunicazione chiare e fiduciose, sia scritte che verbali
• Siete in grado di gestire più priorità, lavorare in modo indipendente e fornire in un ambiente veloce
• Sei curioso, proattivo e orientato alla soluzione, con un forte spirito di squadra
• Un accordo di tirocinio tripartito è obbligatorio Informazioni aggiuntive: TotalEnergies valuta la diversità, promuove la crescita individuale e offre carriere pari opportunità.

Neugierig, wie KI Geschäfts-, Rechts- und Innovationslandschaften verändert? Wenn ja, würden wir gerne Ihr Profil sehen, da wir nach unserem nächsten Praktikanten suchen, der für einen Zeitraum von 6 Monaten unserem Legal-Team beitritt. Über uns TotalEnergies hat eine starke Expertise im Öl- und Biokraftstoff-, Erdgas- und Stromhandel entwickelt. Handelsgesellschaften haben ihren Sitz in Genf, Paris, Houston und Singapur. TotalEnergies hat sein europäisches Handelszentrum in Genf installiert, das jetzt sehr große Teams rund um Handelsaktivitäten zusammenbringt: TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping (T & S) und TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP). T&S ist ein Handelsunternehmen, das für den gesamten physischen Handel und Versand von Rohöl und raffinierten Produkten im Auftrag der TotalEnergies Company verantwortlich ist. Es war ein aktiver Teilnehmer in der gesamten Lieferkette sowie auf dem Derivatepapiermarkt, um das Marktrisiko für eine lange Zeit zu managen. TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP) ist der Handelszweig von TotalEnergies im Bereich der kohlenstoffarmen Energien. Als solches ist es in einer sich schnell entwickelnden Marktdynamik tätig, die von internen und externen Faktoren beeinflusst wird, die eine ständige Anpassung und Entwicklung erfordern. Aktivitäten: Luminanz ist eine neue Lösung, die Vertragsmanagement, Workflow-Automatisierung, Metadatenextraktion und künstliche Intelligenz kombiniert, um Vertragserstellung, Überprüfung, Verhandlung und Governance-Aktivitäten im gesamten Unternehmen zu unterstützen. Sie unterstützen den Einsatz, die Konfiguration, das Testen und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Luminance im gesamten Handelsgeschäft:
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Konfiguration und dem Testen von Luminanzfunktionalitäten und Workflows.
• Unterstützen Sie Benutzerakzeptanztests (UAT) und dokumentieren Sie Probleme und Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten.
• Beitrag zu KI-gestützten vertraglichen Risikoanalyse-Tools und Playbooks.
• Unterstützung bei der zeitnahen Entwicklung, Prüfung und Optimierung für die Vertragsüberprüfung.
• Unterstützung von Metadatenextraktions-, Validierungs- und Vertragsinformationen.
• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung und Pflege von Vorlagen, Klauselbibliotheken und Verhandlungsspielbüchern.
• Bereiten Sie Schulungsmaterialien, Präsentationen und Kommunikationspakete vor.
• Unterstützung von Change Management und User Adoption Aktivitäten.
• Koordinieren Sie das Benutzerfeedback und unterstützen Sie das Problem-Tracking.
• Beitrag zu Innovationsinitiativen mit Generative AI, Automatisierung und Legal Tech. Bewerberprofil:
• Sie verfolgen derzeit einen Master-Abschluss in Law, Business, Engineering, Innovation, Legal Tech oder einem verwandten Bereich
• Sie haben ein starkes Interesse an Künstlicher Intelligenz, digitaler Transformation und neuen Technologien
• Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete analytische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten, kombiniert mit starken organisatorischen Fähigkeiten
• Sie haben klare und sichere Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich
• Sie können mehrere Prioritäten verwalten, unabhängig arbeiten und in einer schnelllebigen Umgebung liefern
• Sie sind neugierig, proaktiv und lösungsorientiert mit einem starken Teamgeist
• Ein dreigliedriger Praktikumsvertrag ist verpflichtend Zusätzliche Informationen: TotalEnergies legt Wert auf Vielfalt, fördert individuelles Wachstum und bietet Chancengleichheit.

Acteur clé du développement des talents à l’échelle mondiale, TGI contribue à offrir une expérience collaborateur de qualité tout au long des parcours internationaux. jobs.title: Corporate Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies has developed strong expertise across oil and biofuels, natural gas, electricity and low-carbon energy trading. Our trading activities are conducted from key international hubs, including Geneva, Paris, Houston and Singapore. Geneva is home to TotalEnergies’ European trading hub, bringing together large and diverse teams across Trading & Shipping and TotalEnergies Gas and Power. TotalEnergies Gas and Power is the Company’s trading arm for gas, electricity, liquefied natural gas, carbon emissions and other low-carbon energies. It operates in fast-moving and increasingly regulated markets, requiring continuous adaptation, strong risk awareness and robust compliance frameworks. The Geneva trading teams are responsible for optimizing purchase and sales portfolios across recognized global markets, while operating in accordance with the Company’s trading guidelines and applicable laws and regulations. Within this dynamic environment, the Compliance team plays a central role in protecting the integrity of our activities and supporting the sustainable growth of the business. Activities: As a Corporate Compliance Officer within the Geneva Compliance team, you will act as a key point of contact for day-to-day corporate compliance, integrity and sanctions-related matters. You will contribute to strengthening the compliance and risk-awareness culture across TotalEnergies Gas and Power, working closely with business teams, senior management and internal and external stakeholders. Your main responsibilities will include:
• Implementing TotalEnergies’ integrity policies and compliance programmes, including anti-corruption, antitrust and anti-money laundering requirements.
• Supporting the development, implementation and continuous improvement of compliance procedures, systems and internal controls.
• Ensuring that compliance policies, procedures, databases and supporting documentation remain accurate and up to date.
• Promoting a strong compliance culture across the organization through regular communication, guidance and awareness initiatives.
• Coordinating and delivering compliance training, including annual compliance seminars, onboarding sessions for new employees and traders, and dedicated awareness programmes.
• Promoting and supporting the use of compliance training tools and e-learning platforms.
• Conducting corruption risk assessments and compliance due diligence on counterparties, business partners and other relevant third parties.
• Advising business teams on the outcome of due diligence reviews and any associated risk-mitigation measures.
• Monitoring regulatory developments and assessing their potential impact on current and future business activities.
• Keeping directors and senior management informed of relevant changes to regulations, internal policies and procedures.
• Supporting the management and development of compliance-related systems, including KYC onboarding tools, compliance intranet pages and gifts and hospitality registers.
• Working with IT and other relevant departments to improve compliance tools, processes and data management.
• Liaising with Compliance teams across other TotalEnergies entities and business lines when required.
• Participating in Integrity Committee meetings where relevant.
• Escalating potential incidents involving corruption, fraud or other compliance concerns in accordance with the applicable internal procedures.
• Preparing quarterly, annual and ad hoc compliance reports for internal stakeholders and Group Compliance teams.

jobs.description:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies has developed a strong expertise in oil and biofuels, natural gas and electricity trading. Trading entities are based in Geneva, Paris, Houston and Singapore. Today, thanks to an international openness, a political and economic stability and strong competences in the financing of commodity trading and shipping, Switzerland has a leading position in international commodity trade. This is why TotalEnergies installed naturally its European trading hub across oil and biofuels, natural gas and electricity in Geneva, which now bring together very large teams around trading activities: Trading & Shipping (T&S) and TotalEnergies Gas and Power (TGP). T&S is a trading company in charge of all physical trading and shipping of crude oil and refined products on behalf of the TotalEnergies Company. It has been an active participant all over the supply chain as well as on the derivatives paper market in order to manage the market risk for a long time). As such, it operates in fast-evolving market dynamics influenced by internal and external factors that require constant adaptation and evolution. Activities: Within TotalEnergies Trading & Shipping (TOTSA) in Geneva, we are looking for a Derivative & Market Risk Analyst to join the Market Risk Control team . The position is at the interface between the Front Office, the Finance department and the company's management. The Middle Office works in a demanding and particularly reactive environment, which requires an excellent vision of the Derivatives Trading activities. Through recurring tasks, one-off studies and developments, this position offers a varied and dynamic work environment linked to the diversity of financial operations and market fluctuations. Key responsibilities Derivatives Middle Office provides daily comprehensive monitoring of market activities which revolves around three themes: 1.- Monitoring exposure and market risks incurred by trading portfolios. 2.- Calculation and publication of daily results. 3.- Support and assistance for derivatives traders Monitoring exposure and market risks: The Middle Office analyses all transactions processed the previous trading day (transactions in over-the-counter or concluded on organized markets ). It monitors daily variations in the books and measure the impact on various risk factors. It studies the overall exposure of profit centers and their sensitivity to market fluctuations especially through a VAR /STRESS TEST analysis. It ensures compliance with the limits delegated to “Trading” and provides the management with indicators. Calculation and publication of daily results: The Middle Office measures the daily unit performance and exercise control over the consistency of information available: characteristics of individual operations and valuation parameters. He is in charge of validating valuation curves or "MTM" retained by traders (consistency check on price structures and comparison with external sources for the most liquid indices). It sets each day the overall outcome of each profit center and reports to management. Support and trading support: The middle office financial analyst also participates in the development and validation of information systems in collaboration with IT teams and financial engineering (testing and validation of the transaction pricing models, exposure tracking tools). It supports the traders through statistical analysis, quantitative performance of different trading strategies undertaken and develops management support tools. The Derivatives Middle Office Analyst will participate to the daily tasks described above and will analyse and implement new risk tools for management and traders. Candidate Profile:
• Master’s degree in one of the following areas: Quantitative Finance / Financial Engineering with a solid quantitative basis and knowledge of derivatives and modelling of stochastic processes.
• High level Python programming skills combined with excellent mathematical background. Excel proficiency, SQL database & VBA required.
• Knowledge in commodities market and derivatives instruments (option pricing models / swap / future).
• Operationally responsive and able to work in project mode.
• Able to work in an evolving environment where pressure and urgency are daily occurrences.
• Analytical mind that allows you to have a thorough comprehension of trading and marketing activities and to present complex problems in a precise and concise way.
• Fluently speak English. Ability to speak French will be an advantage.
• Working as a team player, you have excellent attitude towards work, being resilient, and goal oriented with a keen willingness to learn.
• Communicator with the ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders.
• Ability to work under pressure, in emergency and doing multi-task altogether. Additional Information: TotalEnergies values diversity, promotes individual growth and offers equal opportunity careers.

jobs.description:
Context & Environment: TotalEnergies has developed strong expertise in oil and biofuels, natural gas, electricity and low-carbon energies. Our trading activities are conducted from our main hubs in Geneva, Paris, Houston, Dubai and Singapore. Based in Geneva, you will join the Trading Administration team and provide administrative and logistical support to Management, Heads of Desk and Traders. This position is offered as a fixed-term contract to cover maternity leave, from November 2026 until June 2027 . The role operates in a fast-paced, open-plan trading environment where priorities can change quickly. It requires responsiveness, discretion, flexibility and a strong service mindset. Activities: As an Administrative Assistant, your main responsibilities will be to:
• Provide daily administrative support to the Trading Floor.
• Maintain personnel information, telephone directories, seating plans and employee presence records.
• Organize business travel, including transportation, accommodation, visa applications and travel authorizations.
• Prepare and follow up on expense reports and reimbursement requests.
• Receive and distribute mail, parcels and courier deliveries.
• Coordinate registrations for conferences and training sessions.
• Prepare meeting rooms and ensure that the necessary equipment is available.
• Support the organization of internal events, workshops, conferences and after-work activities.
• Welcome visitors and provide ad hoc support to the trading teams.
• Respond efficiently to urgent and last-minute requests. Candidate Profile:
• You have previous experience in an administrative assistant, team assistant or similar support role.
• Experience in a trading, banking, financial services or other fast-paced corporate environment would be an advantage.
• You are fluent in French and have a good professional level of English.
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint. Knowledge of Microsoft Copilot would be an asset.
• You have strong organizational skills and excellent attention to detail.
• You are able to manage several priorities, follow up effectively and meet deadlines.
• You are responsive, adaptable and comfortable working under pressure.
• You demonstrate strong interpersonal skills and a service-oriented approach.
• You are reliable, discreet and able to handle confidential information.
• You can work independently, take initiative and collaborate effectively with different stakeholders. We are committed to meet the energy needs of a growing population and we are committed to the energy transition. The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. Context & Environment: Location: Geneva, Switzerland Proposed internship duration: 6 months Starting date: October 2026 (preferred) Take your first steps into a fulfilling career and join our team as an intern! Are you looking to grow your career in the vibrant world of energy trading and shipping? Are you ready to help us innovate and grow with your entrepreneurial vision? If yes, we would love to see your profile! We are looking for innovative minds ready to take initiative and to help bringing our new projects to life. Activities: Join our New Ventures team within the Power Trading and Origination division at TotalEnergies. This is an exciting opportunity to work in an international, fast-paced trading environment. The team is instrumental in driving the global growth of our power trading activities, aligning with TotalEnergies’ ambitious goals in the power sector:
• Identify and open new markets with a strong understanding of regulation framework
• Enhance our expertise and enter new markets through acquisitions (M&A)
• Monitor the integration of new assets and teams within the power trading perimeter.
• Develop an internal vision for the future of the power trading entity As an intern, you will be actively involved in all New Ventures activities and will interact with a diverse range of internal (trading desks, legal, research) and external (consultants, potential partners) stakeholders. • Regulatory Monitoring and Analysis:
• Scan updates and changes in energy trading regulations, policies, and market rules at local, national, and European levels.
• Summarize regulatory developments and assess their potential impact on trading activities.
• Propose key actions to adapt the Trading Power strategy to a regulatory change and/or identify business development opportunities and/or implementing measures to mitigate underlying risks
• Business Development & new market entry:
• Gain an understanding of the Electricity Market Design and regulatory framework (support to renewables and long-term PPA, capacity mechanisms, balancing management,) of a given new European country prospective for Trading Power
• Prepare all the key documents necessary for entering market entry (licensing procedure, contracts with TSO, exchanges…), supported, when required with external consultants.
• Draw out key learnings to support country specific business strategies and commercial to advise originators and traders on commercial opportunities for existing and new regulations
• Internal coordination & Influence:
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Trading, Legal, Risk, and Compliance) in regulatory projects and initiatives in timely completion of tasks and deliverables.
• Assist in drafting regulatory internal communication such as flash email, webinar, internal reports
• Assist to the public consultation response by preparing responses to national authorities The New Ventures team is multi-cultural, with members based in Geneva, Houston, Madrid and the UK. • You are detail-oriented, think critically, and can analyse complex information effectively.
• Additionally, you approach tasks with rigour, ensuring thoroughness and precision in your work.
• You possess a business-oriented mindset combined with excellent organizational skills, enabling you to manage multiple tasks effectively and prioritize competing deadlines.
• You have basic knowledge of but strong interest in the energy market.
• You can synthesize complex and technical regulatory information and present it clearly, concisely, and accurately in English. Proficiency in French or another relevant language is a plus.

The volatility of the energy trading markets requires excellence in risk management and a culture of innovation. We are fully embracing the digital revolution. Our people flourish in an environment that promotes expertise, entrepreneurship spirit, agility and a purpose-driven culture, generating boundless opportunities to learn, grow and achieve collaborative success. • Coordinamento interno & Influenza:
• Collabora con team interfunzionali (Trading, Legal, Risk e Compliance) in progetti e iniziative di regolamentazione nel completamento tempestivo dei compiti e dei responsabili.
• Assist nella redazione della comunicazione interna di regolamentazione come e-mail flash, webinar, report interni
• Assistere alla risposta della consultazione pubblica preparando le risposte alle autorità nazionali Il team di New Ventures è multi-culturale, con membri con sede a Ginevra, Houston, Madrid e Regno Unito. Apprezziamo la condivisione di idee, conoscenze e competenze, e crediamo che la collaborazione sia la chiave del nostro successo collettivo. Profilo del candidato:
• Sei iscritto a un Master (Engineering, Business).
• Siete orientati al dettaglio, pensate in modo critico e in grado di analizzare le informazioni complesse in modo efficace.
• Inoltre, ti avvicini alle attività con rigore, garantendo precisione e precisione nel tuo lavoro.
• Possiedi una mentalità orientata al business combinata con eccellenti capacità organizzative, consentendo di gestire più compiti in modo efficace e priorità scadenze concorrenti.
• Hai una conoscenza di base di ma forte interesse per il mercato dell'energia.
• È possibile sintetizzare informazioni normative complesse e tecniche e presentarle chiaramente, concisamente e con precisione in inglese. La competenza in francese o in un'altra lingua rilevante è un vantaggio.
• La posizione richiede l'autonomia, l'obiettività, l'innovazione, per essere piena di risorse e ben organizzata. Siamo impegnati a soddisfare le esigenze energetiche di una popolazione in crescita e ci impegniamo alla transizione energetica. La volatilità dei mercati del trading energetico richiede l'eccellenza nella gestione dei rischi e una cultura dell'innovazione. Stiamo abbracciando pienamente la rivoluzione digitale. Le nostre persone fioriscono in un ambiente che promuove competenze, spirito di imprenditorialità, agilità e una cultura mirata, generando opportunità sconfinate per imparare, crescere e raggiungere il successo collaborativo. Rafforzare le competenze del nostro popolo è un pilastro fondamentale della nostra cultura: formiamo il nostro popolo per garantire il loro sviluppo e ci impegniamo a incoraggiare la sicurezza in tutte le nostre azioni. Cerchiamo passione, ambizione e mentalità aperta. Mentre ci evolgiamo in un settore esigente che richiede di essere sempre al limite, coltiviamo un luogo di lavoro amichevole dove la nostra gente si sente bene, dove lo spirito di squadra e il rispetto guidano la nostra routine quotidiana, dove la diversità della nostra gente e le loro abilità creano un'esperienza nutriente per tutti noi. Informazioni aggiuntive: TotalEnergies valori diversità, promuove la crescita individuale e offre carriere pari opportunità.

Möchten Sie Ihre Karriere in der pulsierenden Welt des Energiehandels und der Schifffahrt ausbauen? Sind Sie bereit, uns bei der Innovation und dem Wachstum mit Ihrer unternehmerischen Vision zu unterstützen? Wenn ja, würden wir gerne Ihr Profil sehen! Wir suchen innovative Köpfe, die bereit sind, Initiative zu ergreifen und dazu beizutragen, unsere neuen Projekte zum Leben zu erwecken. Aktivitäten: Treten Sie unserem New Ventures-Team im Bereich Power Trading und Origination bei TotalEnergies bei. Dies ist eine aufregende Gelegenheit, in einem internationalen, schnelllebigen Handelsumfeld zu arbeiten. Das Team ist maßgeblich daran beteiligt, das globale Wachstum unserer Stromhandelsaktivitäten voranzutreiben und sich an den ehrgeizigen Zielen von TotalEnergies im Stromsektor zu orientieren:
• Identifizieren und Erschließen neuer Märkte mit einem starken Verständnis des Regulierungsrahmens
• Ausbau unserer Expertise und Erschließung neuer Märkte durch Akquisitionen (M&A)
• Überwachen Sie die Integration neuer Assets und Teams innerhalb des Power Trading Perimeters.
• Entwicklung einer internen Vision für die Zukunft der Energiehandelseinheit Als Praktikant bist du aktiv an allen New Ventures-Aktivitäten beteiligt und interagierst mit einer Vielzahl von internen (Handelsabteilungen, Juristen, Research) und externen (Beratern, potenziellen Partnern) Stakeholdern. Ihre Praktikumsmissionen umfassen:
• Regulatorische Überwachung und Analyse:
• Scannen Sie Updates und Änderungen der Vorschriften, Richtlinien und Marktregeln für den Energiehandel auf lokaler, nationaler und europäischer Ebene.
• Fassen Sie die regulatorischen Entwicklungen zusammen und bewerten Sie deren potenzielle Auswirkungen auf die Handelsaktivitäten.
• Schlagen Sie wichtige Maßnahmen vor, um die Trading Power-Strategie an eine regulatorische Änderung anzupassen und / oder Geschäftsentwicklungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und / oder Maßnahmen zur Minderung der zugrunde liegenden Risiken durchzuführen
• Business Development & neuer Markteintritt:
• Verschaffen Sie sich ein Verständnis des Strommarktdesigns und des regulatorischen Rahmens (Unterstützung erneuerbarer Energien und langfristiger PPA, Kapazitätsmechanismen, Bilanzierungsmanagement) eines bestimmten neuen europäischen Landes mit Aussicht auf Handelsmacht
• Bereiten Sie alle für den Markteintritt erforderlichen Schlüsseldokumente (Lizenzverfahren, Verträge mit ÜNB, Börsen usw.) vor, die bei Bedarf von externen Beratern unterstützt werden.
• Erstellen Sie wichtige Erkenntnisse zur Unterstützung länderspezifischer Geschäftsstrategien und zur Beratung von Originatoren und Händlern zu kommerziellen Möglichkeiten für bestehende und neue Vorschriften
• Interne Koordination & Einfluss:
• Arbeiten Sie mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams (Trading, Legal, Risk und Compliance) in regulatorischen Projekten und Initiativen zusammen, um Aufgaben und Ergebnisse rechtzeitig zu erledigen.
• Unterstützung bei der Erstellung regulatorischer interner Kommunikation wie Flash-E-Mail, Webinar, interne Berichte
• Unterstützung der Reaktion auf die öffentliche Konsultation durch Vorbereitung von Antworten an die nationalen Behörden Das New Ventures Team ist multikulturell und hat Mitglieder in Genf, Houston, Madrid und Großbritannien. Wir schätzen den Austausch von Ideen, Wissen und Fachwissen und glauben, dass Zusammenarbeit der Schlüssel zu unserem gemeinsamen Erfolg ist. Bewerberprofil:
• Sie sind in einem Master (Engineering, Business) eingeschrieben.
• Sie sind detailorientiert, denken kritisch und können komplexe Informationen effektiv analysieren.
• Darüber hinaus gehen Sie Aufgaben mit Strenge an und gewährleisten Gründlichkeit und Präzision in Ihrer Arbeit.
• Sie verfügen über eine unternehmensorientierte Denkweise in Kombination mit hervorragenden organisatorischen Fähigkeiten, so dass Sie mehrere Aufgaben effektiv verwalten und konkurrierende Termine priorisieren können.
• Sie haben Grundkenntnisse, aber starkes Interesse am Energiemarkt.
• Sie können komplexe und technische regulatorische Informationen synthetisieren und sie klar, prägnant und genau in Englisch präsentieren. Kenntnisse in Französisch oder einer anderen relevanten Sprache sind ein Plus.
• Die Position erfordert Autonomie, Objektivität, Innovation, um einfallsreich und gut organisiert zu sein. Wir verpflichten uns, den Energiebedarf einer wachsenden Bevölkerung zu decken, und wir engagieren uns für die Energiewende. Die Volatilität der Energiehandelsmärkte erfordert hervorragendes Risikomanagement und eine Innovationskultur. Wir nehmen die digitale Revolution voll und ganz auf. Unsere Mitarbeiter gedeihen in einem Umfeld, das Fachwissen, Unternehmergeist, Agilität und eine zielgerichtete Kultur fördert und grenzenlose Möglichkeiten zum Lernen, Wachsen und gemeinsamen Erfolg schafft. Die Stärkung der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeiter ist eine wichtige Säule unserer Kultur: Wir schulen unsere Mitarbeiter, um ihre Entwicklung zu gewährleisten, und wir verpflichten uns, die Sicherheit in all unseren Handlungen zu fördern. Wir suchen Leidenschaft, Ehrgeiz und Offenheit. Während wir uns in einer anspruchsvollen Branche entwickeln, die immer am Rande sein möchte, pflegen wir einen freundlichen Arbeitsplatz, an dem sich unsere Mitarbeiter wohlfühlen, in dem Teamgeist und Respekt unseren Alltag leiten, in dem die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeiter und ihre Fähigkeiten eine nährende Erfahrung für uns alle schaffen. Nous sommes déterminés à répondre aux besoins énergétiques d'une population croissante et nous sommes engagés dans la transition énergétique. La volatilité des marchés du commerce de l'énergie exige l'excellence dans la gestion des risques et une culture de l'innovation. Nous acceptons pleinement la révolution numérique. Nos gens s'épanouissent dans un environnement qui favorise l'expertise, l'esprit d'entreprise, l'agilité et une culture axée sur l'objectif, créant des occasions illimitées d'apprendre, de grandir et de réussir en collaboration. Renforcer les compétences de notre peuple est un pilier clé de notre culture : nous formons notre peuple à assurer son développement et nous nous engageons à encourager la sécurité dans toutes nos actions. Nous recherchons passion, ambition et ouverture d'esprit. Alors que nous évoluons dans une industrie exigeante qui demande à être toujours à la pointe, nous cultivons un milieu de travail amical où nos gens se sentent bien, où l'esprit d'équipe et le respect guident notre routine quotidienne, où la diversité de nos gens et leurs compétences créent une expérience nourrissante pour nous tous. Informations complémentaires: TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, favorise la croissance individuelle et offre des carrières sur un pied d'égalité.
